candidate_evidence.quote: Pitavastatin calcium (other names: Alipza): Daily Pitavastatin administration

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Eligible for resection of a suspected primary glioblastoma or a recurrent glioblastoma.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Intratumoral pitavastatin concentration as assessed by LC-MS analysis on tumour tissue.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Differences in RNA expression after pitavastatin exposure in tumour tissue using RNA sequencing.

role_evidence.quote: Pitavastatin 16 mg via oral route in the form of daily tablets for 6 days before SOC surgery

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: reaches a cytotoxic concentration in gadolinium-enhanced tumour tissue

coder_notes: Phase 0 (EARLY_PHASE1) pre-operative window study with three pitavastatin dose groups. Temozolomide is mentioned only as a possible synergy partner, not given in the trial, so not listed. RNA sequencing of tumour is not tied to a named molecular biomarker, so no biomarker row.
